purpose: test whether frozen R2 can rank unknown support/material candidates by receiver mismatch before physical verification

target.role: new development diagnostic; not final test

truth_policy: target used only to generate observation and posthoc statistics; no target-based threshold or early stopping
scope: known support shape but heldout support row, source0, scalar density; not blind defect identification or final test
